_about: NOAA NCEI Global Significant Earthquake Database (doi:10.7289/V5TD9V7K): events with deaths, $1M+ damage, magnitude 7.5+, intensity X+ or a tsunami. magnitude: NCEI's preferred magnitude. Times UTC. Dates before 1582-10-15 are taken as Julian (as historical catalogues record them); a day without a time is cast at local noon, tz_east being the place's mean time.
